newsitem.title: UK: Siebe says NatWest relationship unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Siebe says NatWest relationship unchanged.

text.p: British engineering group Siebe Plc on Wednesday denied a press report that it was reviewing its relationship with NatWest Bank after a NatWest research document advised investors to sell Siebe stock.
"NatWest has been Siebe's bank for over a hundred years. All of our historic relationships continue as normal. NatWest is still one of our three lead bankers globally," a Siebe spokesman said.
"We accept that every now and again NatWest Capital Markets may have a different view from other analysts. We don't necessarily agree with it," he said.
Siebe shares were 14-1/2p ahead at 912p after Dresdner Kleinwort Benson reiterated its "buy" stance on the stock. The shares have fallen in the last week after breaking key technical support levels.
